verbs.name: slcode.new
verbs.help: Open a slcode session card in the deck of this terminal; prints the session id

args.name: cwd
args.help: session folder (default: this shell's cwd)

args.name: vendor
args.help: claude | codex

args.name: mode
args.help: default | auto | bypassPermissions (default: auto)

args.name: model
args.help: model of the new session (default: the vendor's default); anthropic:<model> or openai:<model> also picks the vendor (claude | codex)

args.name: effort
args.help: effort of the new session — claude: low | medium | high | xhigh | max (default: the vendor's default; a value the model lacks warns in the session and falls back to the default)

args.name: profile
args.help: start profile of the new session — default | bare | one made with slcode profile add (default: default; before the first message it can be changed in the middle of the chat)

args.name: env
args.help: env of the session's Claude/Codex process, kept for resume and vendor restarts; several pairs go in one value, one per line (a repeated --env keeps only the last); SLCODE_* names are refused

args.name: param
args.help: session param, kept for resume: agent plugin parts with a when param condition read it, js/ts hooks see hook.session.params and the agent process env SLCODE_PARAM_<NAME>; several pairs go in one value, one per line

args.name: prompt
args.help: first prompt — starts the first turn as soon as the session is up

args.name: focus
args.help: show the new card if you are looking at this terminal right then (default: attach it quietly; slcode new passes it when a person types it)

verbs.name: slcode.start
verbs.help: Open the slcode start screen as a card in the deck of this terminal — new session (pick a profile), resume a closed session, add a profile

args.name: cwd
args.help: folder of the start screen (default: this shell's cwd)

verbs.name: slcode.team
verbs.help: Start a teammate of a live slcode session, like slcode team new run in it, and open its card in the deck of this terminal; prints the teammate id

args.name: leader
args.help: the leader session (required) — pass SLCODE_SESSION_ID of the shell that asked

args.name: subagent
args.help: relation preset subagent

args.name: teammate
args.help: relation preset teammate (the default)

args.name: detached
args.help: relation preset detached

args.name: cwd
args.help: folder it works in (default: this shell's cwd); not with --worktree

args.name: worktree
args.help: run it in a new git worktree <repo>.worktrees/<name> on a new branch <name> (a / becomes - in the folder) from the HEAD of this shell's cwd

args.name: name
args.help: its name (title)

args.name: options
args.help: team options over the preset, e.g. {"notifyEnd":false}

args.name: agent
args.help: agent definition

args.name: model
args.help: model name, or anthropic:<model> / openai:<model> (default: the leader's)

args.name: effort
args.help: effort (default: the leader's)

args.name: mode
args.help: permission mode (default: the leader's)

args.name: profile
args.help: start profile

args.name: env
args.help: env of its Claude/Codex process; several pairs in one value, one per line

args.name: param
args.help: session param; several pairs in one value, one per line

args.name: prompt
args.help: its first instructions

verbs.name: slcode.resume
verbs.help: Open a saved slcode session as a card in the deck of this terminal; without --id, pick a closed session of --cwd

args.name: id
args.help: session id

args.name: cwd
args.help: folder whose closed sessions to pick from (default: this shell's cwd)
